description: This file is a C++ source file implementing Android-specific main loop and activity callbacks for the Cobalt project, including thread management, command handling, and integration with Android lifecycle events.

classes.name: ApplicationAndroid
classes.description: Android application interface handling lifecycle events and input events.

classes.name: GameActivity
classes.description: Represents the Android activity with callback hooks for lifecycle and input events.

methods.name: GetArgs
methods.description: Retrieves command-line arguments from Java environment.

methods.name: GetStartDeepLink
methods.description: Retrieves the start deep link URL from Java environment.

methods.name: CopyDirContents
methods.description: Copies contents of one directory to another (used for extracting certificates).

methods.name: ExtractCertificatesToFileSystem
methods.description: Extracts CA certificates from APK to filesystem.

methods.name: InstallCrashpadHandler
methods.description: Sets up crash reporting handler with extracted certificates.

methods.name: ThreadEntryPoint
methods.description: Main thread function for the Starboard application, initializes and runs the main loop.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Handles activity start event, sends start command.

methods.name: OnResume
methods.description: Handles activity resume event, sends resume command.

methods.name: OnPause
methods.description: Handles activity pause event, sends pause command.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Handles activity stop event, sends stop command.

methods.name: GameActivity_onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, starts the main thread, and sets callback hooks.

methods.name: SbRunStarboardMain
methods.description: Main entry point for running the Starboard application loop.
